observations: Photo shows a black console with 'SONY' and a partial 'PS4' logo visible on the front edge, stacked under two controller boxes.
Console body has the stepped/ridged design typical of the PS4 Pro shape, but no model-number sticker or rear panel is visible.
Two sealed-looking retail boxes for red 'DUALSHOCK 4' PS4 wireless controllers are stacked on top of the console.
No games, discs, cables, power brick, or HDMI/power ports are visible in the frame.
Image carries two overlaid watermarks ('POSTED ON...' and 'GAME ARENA OFFICIAL'), suggesting this may be a reused catalog/stock photo rather than a photo of the actual unit being sold.
No power-on screen, serial number, or close-up of scuffs/wear is shown to support the 'very clean' or 'UK-used' claims.

identity.kind: game console with two wireless controllers
identity.model: PlayStation 4 (Pro shape, model number not visible)

claims.claim: Very clean UK-Used PS4 Pro console
claims.evidence: No close-up of console body, ports, or serial/model sticker to confirm cleanliness, UK origin, or Pro variant specifically.
No games, cases, or discs appear anywhere in photo 0.
Photo 0 shows two boxed DualShock 4 controllers stacked on the console.
Photo 0 shows a ridged body consistent with Pro styling, but no model number (e.g., CUH-7xxx) is legible.

risks.risk: Photo may be a stock/catalog image (double watermark) rather than the actual unit for sale, so true condition is unknown.
risks.proof: A fresh, unwatermarked photo of the actual console and controllers next to a handwritten date/name note.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unverified, i.e. at the low end for 'used, condition unknown'

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (disc drive, HDMI port, overheating/fan noise).
risks.proof: A video of the console powering on to the PS4 home screen, with controller pairing shown.

risks.risk: '10 games' may be absent, pirated/jailbroken discs, or digital-only entitlements tied to a foreign account.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual game case stack or the console's game library screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-and-controllers only, no games included

risks.risk: Model may be a standard PS4 (not Pro) despite the claim, affecting resale value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear/bottom model-number sticker (e.g., CUH-7xxx series).
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard PS4, not Pro

risks.risk: Controllers in sealed boxes could be empty boxes, counterfeit, or a different color/condition than advertised.
risks.proof: A photo of both controllers removed from the box, powered on and paired to the console.

risks.risk: 'UK-used' implies a UK power plug/PSU; a mismatched plug could mean added cost for a converter or a swapped, non-original PSU.
risks.proof: A photo of the power brick and plug type.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming a non-original or mismatched power supply

proof_requests: A live, unwatermarked photo of the actual console and controllers with a handwritten date/name.
A power-on video showing the PS4 boot screen and both controllers paired.
A clear photo of the console's rear/bottom model-number sticker.
A photo of the 10 games (cases or in-console library list).
A photo of the power brick/plug type.
response.reason: The item type (a PS4-style console bundled with two boxed DualShock 4 controllers) is identifiable from the photo, so it can be priced at worst case: condition, functionality, Pro status, and included games all unverified, with controllers treated as unverified authenticity until proven.
